source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 1 exercise solved (PDF 34-35): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which domain of life is characterized by organisms that often inhabit extreme environments and have cell membranes with ether-linked lipids?
(Zindagi ka kaun sa domain aise jandaron ka hai jo aksar shadeed mahol (extreme environments) mein rehte hain aur jin ki cell membrane mein ether-linked lipids hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Archaea ki membrane ke lipids mein glycerol aur branched fatty acid chains ke darmiyan ether linkage hoti hai; is liye un ki membrane shadeed halaat (extreme conditions) bardasht kar leti hai (1.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. What is a key difference between the domains Bacteria and Archaea?
(Domain Bacteria aur Archaea mein ek aham farq kya hai?)

options.text: Bacteria mein membrane-bound organelles hote hain, Archaea mein nahi.
Bacteria ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan hota hai, Archaea ki cell wall mein nahi.
Archaea sirf shadeed mahol mein milte hain, Bacteria nahi.
Saare bacteria unicellular hain jabke Archaea mein multicellular jandar bhi hain.

blocks.explanation: Bacteria ki cell wall peptidoglycan ki hoti hai; Archaea ki wall mein peptidoglycan nahi, balke doosre polysaccharides aur proteins hote hain (kuch mein pseudopeptidoglycan). Dono prokaryotes hain, kisi mein membrane-bound organelles nahi (1.1).

blocks.prompt:
3. Which of the following kingdoms includes organisms that are mostly unicellular, eukaryotic, and can be autotrophic or heterotrophic?
(Kaun si kingdom aise jandaron ki hai jo zyada tar unicellular, eukaryotic hain aur autotrophic ya heterotrophic ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Protoctista (Protista) eukaryotes hain jo zyada tar unicellular hain (kuch colonial, filamentous ya saade multicellular); algae autotrophic (khud khana banane wale) aur protozoa heterotrophic (doosron se khana lene wale) hain (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
4. In which kingdom are organisms predominantly multicellular, autotrophic, and have cell walls made of cellulose?
(Kis kingdom ke jandar zyada tar multicellular, autotrophic hain aur un ki cell wall cellulose ki hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plants eukaryotic, multicellular aur autotrophic (photosynthesis karne wale) hain aur un ki cell wall cellulose ki hai (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
5. Which of the following criteria is commonly used to classify viruses?
(Viruses ki classification ke liye aam tor par kaun sa criterion (meyar) istemal hota hai?)

options.text: Khaas bimariyan paida karne ki salahiyat
Un ke andar nucleic acid ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Viruses ko zyada tar un ke genetic material (DNA ya RNA, single ya double stranded) se classify kiya jata hai; is ke ilawa replication ka tareeqa, shakal (morphology) aur host bhi dekhe jate hain (1.6).

blocks.prompt:
6. Which virus group includes viruses such as Coronaviruses and influenza viruses?
(Coronaviruses aur influenza viruses kis virus group mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter mein Coronaviruses (COVID-19) aur influenza viruses (flu) ko ssRNA viruses likha gaya hai (1.6).

blocks.prompt:
7. At which level of biodiversity assessment do we evaluate the variety of different species within a particular habitat or ecosystem?
(Biodiversity assessment ke kis level par kisi habitat ya ecosystem mein mukhtalif species ki variety dekhi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Species level par kisi ilaqe ki mukhtalif species ko pehchana aur gina jata hai, un ki tadaad (abundance) aur phailao (distribution) samet (1.7).

blocks.prompt:
8. Which method is best suited for assessing the distribution of species across a gradient of environmental conditions within a single geographical area?
(Ek hi ilaqe mein mahol ke gradient (darja ba darja tabdeeli) ke saath species ka phailao dekhne ke liye kaun sa tareeqa behtareen hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transect ek line ya patti hai jo ilaqe ke aar paar bichhai jati hai aur barabar faaslon par species note ki jati hain; yeh badalte halaat mein phailao dikhata hai, maslan high tide line se low tide line tak (1.7).

blocks.prompt:
9. Which of the following statements is true regarding the concept of a species?
(Species ke concept ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Species hamesha sirf jismani khususiyaat se define hoti hai.
Mukhtalif species aapas mein mil kar fertile bachche paida kar sakti hain.
Ek species ke members doosri species ke members se reproductively isolated (nasl ke lehaz se alag) hote hain.
Species ko sirf genetic mushabehat se define kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.explanation: Biological species concept (Ernst Mayr) mein reproductive isolation sab se aham meyar hai: mukhtalif species ke members aam tor par milap nahi karte ya fertile bachche paida nahi karte (1.8).

blocks.prompt:
10. What type of speciation occurs when populations are geographically separated by a physical barrier?
(Jab populations kisi physical rukawat (barrier) se jughrafiyai tor par alag ho jayein to kaun si speciation hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Allopatric speciation tab hoti hai jab population jughrafiyai tor par alag groups mein bat jaye aur har group alag evolve kare, maslan Darwin's finches (1.8).

blocks.prompt:
1. What are the three domains of life and how do they differ in terms of cellular structure?
Zindagi ke teen domains kaun se hain aur cell ki banawat mein un mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Teen domains: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya.
Archaea aur Bacteria ke cells prokaryotic hain (asal nucleus aur membrane-bound organelles nahi); Archaea ki membrane mein ether-linked lipids aur wall mein peptidoglycan nahi, jabke Bacteria mein ester-linked lipids aur peptidoglycan wali wall hai.
Eukarya ke cells eukaryotic hain: asal nucleus, membrane-bound organelles aur cytoskeleton maujood.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe one key feature that differentiates Archaea from Bacteria.
Ek aham khususiyat bataein jo Archaea ko Bacteria se alag karti hai.
blocks.explanation:
Cell wall: Bacteria ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan hota hai, magar Archaea ki wall mein peptidoglycan nahi hota; us mein doosre polysaccharides aur proteins hote hain (kuch mein pseudopeptidoglycan).
(Doosra farq: Archaea ke membrane lipids mein ether linkage aur branched fatty acids, Bacteria mein ester linkage aur unbranched fatty acids.)

blocks.prompt:
3. Which kingdom is characterized by organisms with chitin in their cell walls and that are mostly decomposers?
Kis kingdom ke jandaron ki cell wall mein chitin hota hai aur woh zyada tar decomposers (gali sari cheezein todne wale) hain?
blocks.explanation: Kingdom Fungi. Fungi eukaryotic heterotrophs hain jin ki cell wall chitin ki hoti hai; woh khana mahol se jazb (absorb) karte hain, maslan mushrooms aur molds.

blocks.prompt:
4. What type of speciation occurs when populations are geographically separated?
Jab populations jughrafiyai tor par alag ho jayein to kaun si speciation hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Allopatric speciation. Alag hone wale groups mukhtalif mahol mein alag evolve karte hain, yahan tak ke aapas mein nasl nahi barha sakte, maslan Galapagos ke Darwin's finches.

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the role of genetic drift in the process of speciation?
Speciation ke amal mein genetic drift ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation:
Genetic drift allele (gene ki shakal) ki frequency mein ittefaqi (random) tabdeeli hai jo ek nasl se doosri nasl mein hoti hai; chhoti population mein sab se zyada (chapter se aage).
Chhoti alag population mein (jaise peripatric speciation mein) drift gene pool ko jaldi badal deta hai, population asal population se mukhtalif ho jati hai aur waqt ke saath reproductive isolation aur nayi species ban sakti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Genetic drift ko aise samjhein: 10 dost hain, 5 ki aankhein bhoori aur 5 ki kaali. Ittefaq se 3 bhoori aankhon wale chale jayein to group mein bhoori aankhein kam ho gayin, kisi faide ya nuqsaan ki wajah se nahi, sirf ittefaq se. Chhote group mein aisi tabdeeli bari hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What is the primary method used to assess species distribution along an environmental gradient?
Mahol ke gradient ke saath species ka phailao dekhne ka bara tareeqa kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Transect sampling: ilaqe ke aar paar ek line ya patti (transect) bichhai jati hai aur us par barabar faaslon par species note ki jati hain, maslan sahil par high tide line se low tide line tak.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which level of biodiversity assessment involves evaluating the variety of ecosystems in a region?
Biodiversity assessment ka kaun sa level kisi ilaqe ke ecosystems ki variety ko dekhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ecosystem level. Is mein habitats ki range (jangal, wetlands, grasslands, registan) aur yeh dekha jata hai ke mukhtalif ecosystems kaise kaam karte hain aur mahol ki sehat mein kya hissa dalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Compare and contrast the domains Archaea and Bacteria and discuss how these differences reflect their evolutionary histories.
Domain Archaea aur Bacteria ka muqabla karein aur bataein ke yeh farq un ki evolutionary tareekh ko kaise zahir karte hain.
blocks.explanation:
Mushabehat: dono prokaryotes hain (asal nucleus aur membrane-bound organelles nahi), zyada tar unicellular, nucleoid mein ek circular chromosome, aur dono asexual tor par (binary fission) barhte hain. Five-kingdom system mein dono kingdom Monera mein the.
Farq table mein hain.
Evolutionary tareekh: Carl Woese (1990) ne bataya ke prokaryotes ke do alag groups hain. Archaea aur Bacteria ek mushtarka ajdad (common ancestor) se alag alag evolve hue aur bohat pehle alag ho gaye (archaios = qadeem). Molecular saboot batate hain ke Archaea ke genetic sequences eukaryotes se milte hain, is liye Eukarya, Archaea wali line se bane. Isi liye Archaea, prokaryote hone ke bawajood, eukaryotes ke zyada qareebi rishtedar hain aur alag domain mein rakhe gaye hain.

rows: Membrane lipids: ether linkage, branched fatty acids
Membrane lipids: ester linkage, unbranched fatty acids
Cell wall mein peptidoglycan nahi (polysaccharides aur proteins; kuch mein pseudopeptidoglycan)
Genes aur un ka control eukaryotes jaisa
Genes aur control eukaryotes se mukhtalif
Bohat se shadeed mahol mein (garmi, namak, tezaab)
Groups: Proteobacteria, Firmicutes, Cyanobacteria, Spirochaetes waghera

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the concept of a species according to the biological species concept. How does this definition help in understanding species boundaries and the process of speciation? Provide examples to illustrate your points.
Biological species concept ke mutabiq species ka tasawwur bayan karein. Yeh tareef species ki hudood aur speciation ko samajhne mein kaise madad deti hai? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Biological species concept (Ernst Mayr): species aapas mein nasl barhane wali qudrati populations ka group hai jo doosre groups se reproductively isolated (nasl ke lehaz se alag) hota hai. Ek species ke members qudrati halaat mein milap kar ke fertile (aage bachche paida karne ke qabil) bachche dete hain; mukhtalif species ke members aam tor par aisa nahi karte.
Species ki hudood: sirf shakal dekhna dhoka de sakta hai, kyun ke cryptic species dekhne mein ek jaisi magar genetically alag hoti hain. Reproductive isolation ko meyar banane se species ki had wahan hai jahan milap ruk jata hai. Misal: tamam insaan (Homo sapiens) ek species hain; ghora aur gadha milap kar sakte hain magar khachar (mule) baanjh (sterile) hota hai, is liye woh alag species hain (misal chapter se aage).
Speciation: nayi species tab banti hai jab ek species ki populations mein genetic tabdeeliyan jama ho kar reproductive isolation paida kar dein. Misalein:
- Allopatric: jughrafiyai rukawat, maslan Darwin's finches.
- Peripatric: kinare ki chhoti population, maslan jazeeron ki species.
- Parapatric: gradient ke saath parosi populations, maslan Anthoxanthum odoratum ghaas.
- Sympatric: isi ilaqe mein, maslan plants mein polyploidy.

blocks.prompt:
3. Discuss the mechanisms of allopatric and sympatric speciation.
Allopatric aur sympatric speciation ke tareeqe (mechanisms) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Allopatric speciation: population kisi jughrafiyai rukawat (pahaar, darya, samandar) se alag groups mein bat jati hai. Un ke darmiyan gene flow (genes ka len den) band ho jata hai. Har group mukhtalif mahol mein rehta hai, mutations aur natural selection se alag evolve hota hai. Waqt ke saath farq itne barh jate hain ke rukawat hatne par bhi woh milap nahi kar sakte. Misal: Galapagos ke Darwin's finches.
Sympatric speciation: nayi species usi ilaqe mein, baghair kisi physical rukawat ke banti hai. Tareeqe:
1. Polyploidy: jandar mein chromosomes ke kai sets aa jate hain; woh asal population ke saath fertile bachche nahi de sakta, is liye foran reproductive isolation. Plants mein aam.
2. Niche differentiation: sub-populations mukhtalif wasail (resources) istemal karti hain, apne group mein milap karti hain aur aahista aahista alag species ban jati hain.
Bara farq: allopatric mein jughrafiyai alahdgi zaroori hai; sympatric usi jagah genetic ya ecological alahdgi se hoti hai.

rows: Usi ilaqe mein, koi rukawat nahi
Gene flow polyploidy ya niche ke farq se band

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the main characteristics of the kingdoms Protoctista, Fungi, Plantae, and Animalia. Provide examples for each kingdom.
Kingdoms Protoctista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia ki bari khususiyaat bayan karein aur har ek ki misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Protoctista (Protista): eukaryotes jo unicellular, colonial, filamentous ya saade multicellular hain (multicellular sex organs nahi). Kuch mein cell wall. Ghiza: photosynthetic, heterotrophic ya dono. Groups: protozoa (janwar jaise: Amoeba, Paramecium, Plasmodium, Trypanosoma), algae (plant jaise, cellulose wall aur chlorophyll: Euglena, diatoms), fungus jaise protists (slime molds, water molds). Kuch bimari dete hain, maslan malaria (Plasmodium).
2. Fungi: eukaryotic, unicellular ya multicellular, heterotrophic. Cell wall chitin ki. Khana mahol se jazb karte hain; bohat se decomposers. Groups: Zygomycota (Rhizopus), Ascomycota (yeasts, morels), Basidiomycota (mushrooms, rusts, smuts). Faide: bread, cheese, penicillin.
3. Plantae: eukaryotic, multicellular, autotrophic (photosynthesis), cellulose ki cell wall, embryo se bante hain. Groups: nonvascular bryophytes (mosses, liverworts) aur vascular plants: seedless (ferns) aur seed plants (conifers, phool wale plants).
4. Animalia: eukaryotic, multicellular, heterotrophic, cell wall nahi; khana nigalte (ingest) aur jism ke andar hazam karte hain; embryo se bante hain. Misalein: sponges, Hydra, flatworms, roundworms, molluscs, annelids, arthropods, echinoderms aur chordates (machhli, parinde, mammals).

blocks.prompt:
5. Outline the major classification systems for viruses based on their structural features and replication methods. Discuss the significance of these classifications in virology.
Viruses ki structure aur replication ke tareeqe par mabni classification ke bare systems bayan karein aur virology mein in ki ahmiyat bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Viruses ki classification International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) ke usoolon par hoti hai.
1. Shakal (morphology):
- Helical: nucleic acid ke gird helical capsid, maslan tobacco mosaic virus, rabies virus.
- Icosahedral: 20 sathon wala capsid, maslan adenoviruses, herpesviruses.
- Complex: icosahedral aur helical hisse aur dum (tail) jaisi cheezein, maslan bacteriophages.
- Enveloped: host ki membrane se bana lipid envelope, maslan influenza, HIV.
- Non-enveloped (naked): sirf capsid, maslan poliovirus.
2. Genetic material: dsDNA (adenoviruses, herpesviruses), ssDNA (parvoviruses), ssRNA (coronaviruses, influenza), dsRNA (rotaviruses).
3. Replication ka tareeqa:
- Positive-sense RNA: RNA seedha host ke ribosomes par protein banata hai (poliovirus, hepatitis C).
- Negative-sense RNA: pehle viral RNA polymerase RNA se mRNA banata hai (rabies, Ebola).
- Reverse transcribing: reverse transcriptase se DNA ke zariye replication (HIV: RNA genome; hepatitis B: DNA genome).
(Host ki bunyad par bhi: animal, plant, bacterial aur archaeal viruses.)
Ahmiyat: rishtedar viruses ek group mein aa jate hain, is liye un ki khususiyaat ka andaza ho jata hai; naya virus jaldi pehchana jata hai; us ke barhne aur phailne ka pata chalta hai; dawaiyan (maslan retroviruses ke liye reverse transcriptase rokne wali) aur vaccines banane mein madad milti hai; aur sab scientists ek hi naam istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain the different levels at which biodiversity can be assessed. How do these levels contribute to our understanding of biological diversity and conservation efforts?
Biodiversity ko kin levels par jancha ja sakta hai? Yeh levels biodiversity aur conservation (tahaffuz) ko samajhne mein kaise madad dete hain?
blocks.explanation:
Biodiversity genes, species aur ecosystems ki satah par zindagi ki rangarangi (variety) hai.
1. Genetic level: ek species ke tamam afraad mein genetic maloomat ki variety. Is se species mahol ki tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhal (adapt) kar zinda rehti hai.
2. Species level: kisi ilaqe ki mukhtalif species ko pehchanna aur ginna, un ki tadaad aur phailao samet.
3. Ecosystem level: ilaqe ke habitats ki range (jangal, wetlands, grasslands, registan) aur yeh ke ecosystems kaise kaam karte hain.
Kirdar:
- Genetic diversity batati hai kaun si population dhal sakti hai; is ka tahaffuz species ko kamzor aur khatam (extinct) hone se bachata hai.
- Species ginti batati hai kaun si species kam ho rahi hain, taake tahaffuz ki tarjeehat tay hon.
- Ecosystem jaanch batati hai kaun se habitats khatre mein hain; poore ecosystem ka tahaffuz us ki tamam species aur genes ko bachata hai.
Teeno levels mil kar poori tasweer dete hain, ahem ilaqe pehchanne aur waqt ke saath tabdeeli dekhne mein madad karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. Discuss the importance of random sampling methods in ecological studies.
Ecological studies mein random sampling ke tareeqon ki ahmiyat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Poore ilaqe ke tamam jandar ginna mumkin nahi, is liye random sampling (ittefaqi namoone lena) biodiversity jaanchne ka bunyadi tareeqa hai. Ahmiyat:
1. Bias (janibdari) kam: ilaqe ke har hisse ka chune jane ka barabar mauqa, is liye nateeja poore ilaqe ki sahi numaindagi karta hai.
2. Qabil-e-aitbaar andaze: data ka statistical tajziya kar ke species richness, tadaad aur phailao ka andaza.
3. Muqabla aasan: ek jaisa tareeqa mukhtalif ilaqon ka muqabla mumkin banata hai.
4. Behtar numaindagi: ilaqe ke mukhtalif hisson se namoone poore ilaqe ki diversity dikhate hain.
5. Tahaffuz mein madad: ahem ilaqe pehchane jate hain aur waqt ke saath tabdeeli dekhi jati hai.
Tareeqe: quadrat sampling, transect sampling, point counts, mark-recapture.

blocks.prompt:
8. Describe the concept of an ecosystem and niche.
Ecosystem aur niche ka tasawwur bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Ecosystem: jandaron aur un ke physical mahol ka ek mutaharrik (dynamic) aur aapas mein jura hua nizam. Is mein tamam biotic factors (plants, janwar, microorganisms) aur abiotic factors (roshni, pani, darja-e-hararat, mitti, hawa) shamil hain jo aik doosre par asar dalte hain; is mein energy behti hai aur madde ghoomte hain. Misalein: talaab, jangal, registan.
Niche: ecosystem mein kisi jandar ya species ka kirdar (kaam). Is mein us ka habitat (rehne ki jagah), doosron se taluqaat (shikar, muqabla, symbiosis) aur energy flow mein us ka kirdar (producer, consumer ya decomposer) shamil hai. Misal (chapter se aage): kenchua (earthworm) geeli mitti mein rehta hai, mara hua organic maadda khata hai, mitti naram karta hai aur parinde use khate hain; yeh sab us ka niche hai.
Yani ecosystem poora nizam hai aur niche us mein ek species ka 'pesha' hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aasan misal: ecosystem ek gaon hai jis mein log, ghar, pani aur khet sab shamil hain. Niche gaon mein kisi ek shakhs ka pesha hai: koi kisaan, koi darzi, koi doctor. Har species ka ecosystem mein apna 'pesha' hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. How are viruses classified based on their nucleic acid content and replication method?
Viruses ko nucleic acid aur replication ke tareeqe ki bunyad par kaise classify kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Nucleic acid: DNA viruses, single-stranded (ssDNA: parvoviruses) ya double-stranded (dsDNA: adenoviruses, herpesviruses); RNA viruses, single-stranded (ssRNA: coronaviruses, influenza) ya double-stranded (dsRNA: rotaviruses).
Replication: positive-sense RNA (RNA seedha mRNA ka kaam karta hai: poliovirus, hepatitis C); negative-sense RNA (pehle viral RNA polymerase mRNA banata hai: rabies, Ebola); reverse transcribing (reverse transcriptase se DNA ke zariye: HIV, hepatitis B).

blocks.prompt:
2. What may be the drawback in the definition of species according to the biological species concept?
Biological species concept ki species wali tareef mein kya khaami ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh concept milap (interbreeding) par mabni hai, is liye kai jagah lagu nahi hota (zyada tar chapter se aage):
1. Asexual tor par barhne wale jandar (bacteria, bohat se protists, kuch plants) milap karte hi nahi.
2. Fossil (khatam ho chuki) species mein milap jaancha nahi ja sakta.
3. Jughrafiyai tor par alag populations kabhi milti nahi, to pata nahi chalta ke qudrati tor par milap karengi ya nahi.
4. Kuch mukhtalif species milap kar ke fertile hybrid bhi deti hain (plants mein aam), jis se had wazeh nahi rehti.
Aise mein species ko shakal, genes ya ecology se pehchana jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. How does biodiversity help maintain balance in an ecosystem?
Biodiversity ecosystem mein tawazun (balance) kaise qaim rakhti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Har species ka energy flow aur nutrients ke chakkar (cycling) mein apna niche hota hai. Zyada biodiversity ho to:
1. Food web pecheeda hota hai: ek species kam ho to shikari doosra shikar khane lagte hain, is liye populations qaboo mein rehti hain aur koi ek species hadd se nahi barhti.
2. Producers, consumers aur decomposers maddon ka chakkar chalate rehte hain (decomposers nutrients mitti ko wapas dete hain).
3. Genetic diversity populations ko tabdeeli aur bimari ke mutabiq dhalne deti hai, is liye ecosystem sookha, aag ya keeron ke baad sambhal jata hai.
4. Ecosystem diversity bohat si species ko habitats deti hai.
Is tarah mukhtalif jandaron wala ecosystem mustahkam (stable) rehta hai; kam diversity use kamzor banati hai (zyada tar chapter se aage).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: agar jangal mein sirf hiran aur sher hon aur hiran bimari se mar jayein to sher bhi bhookay mar jayenge. Agar khargosh, jungli suar aur doosre janwar bhi hon to sher un ko kha kar zinda rahega aur nizam chalta rahega. Yahi biodiversity ka tawazun hai.

items: MCQs ke jawab chapter ke text se: 1b 2b 3d 4c 5b 6d 7c 8c 9c 10c.
Short (7), long (8) aur inquisitive (3) sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath diye gaye hain.
Jo baat chapter se aage hai us par "(chapter se aage)" likha hai: short Q5 (genetic drift), inquisitive Q2 aur Q3.
